items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And Sidney Bechet, he was playing clarinet with us, you see.

ctx.x: And it was the casino dance hall, but it ran by Hunts. Hunts, uh, and Eddie Groeschel. Yeah, that's right. And they called it Hunts and Nagels. Yeah, that's right. Hunts and Nagels. Hunts and Nagels, they called it like that. Yeah. Through Hunts. Yeah, that's right. And Eddie Groeschel. Eddie Groeschel was his partner. It was his partnership. He was a partnership. But the name of it was the casino. Yeah, that's the casino.
Yeah. The other night also we were talking about Sidney Bechet.
Oh, yeah. He told that funny story about him being on the Smoky Mary. Tell us about it.
